name: What are the most common types of interior molding installed during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common types of interior molding installed during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboards, crown molding, door and window casing, and chair rails are the most common trim styles. Baseboards finish the junction between the floor and wall while protecting drywall from impacts. Crown molding softens transitions between walls and ceilings, adding architectural depth. Window and door casings frame openings cleanly. A primary decision factor when choosing profiles is your ceiling height and architectural style: taller ceilings often demand wider baseboards or multi-piece crown profiles, while modern homes typically favor simple, clean flat-stock trim. When remodeling, selecting consistent profiles ties adjacent rooms together seamlessly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include baseboards, crown molding, door and window casing, and chair rails. Ceiling height and existing room style determine the best profile size.
